item.title: Introduction
item.description: Introduction Hullo! I’m Chris, a software engineer making his living in the scenic Pacific Northwest. Recently, I made the decision to change both my phone number as well as to abandon the GMail account I’ve had for over 20 years and replace it with one that isn’t plastered all over the dark web. Since this is a big undertaking, I’ve created this blog to document how I went about changing everything as well as any pitfalls I’ve run into in the hopes that this information will be useful to others.
